I'm 71 and have decent skin, which I think helps with looking good for my age. I've been doing various laser treatments for over 10 years and while it hasn't been miraculous for wrinkles it's kept my skin from having a rough texture or discolorations. This product is an amazing addition to my routine. I've only used it twice, but both times I've ended up with a glow, with light reflecting naturally due to how incredibly smooth my skin is. This will become a regular part of my routine - I love what it does. Plus, if you're someone who likes instant gratification, this will give you that boost because the results are immediately visible. I know a selfie would really make sense here, but I'm too camera shy to include one - sorry!

I got this because I've been working on trying to have nicer skin. I patch tested on my hand it was fine. I put it on my face as directed washed it off and my face felt great... until the next day. I had a lite rash going from cheek to cheek. it was sensive to the touch but not painful, just uncomfortable. Day 2 the area became super dry. I moisturize twice a day and it isn't helping. I am on day 3 and the area is more dry and starting to flake. my face is way worse before I used the product. Really disappointed.

I cant live without this product. I have chicken pox scars on my face and in just one use, this produce helped reduce their appearance. I've worked my way up to using it twice a week as part of my nighttime routine. My skin hasn't looked better in 20 years! If you have sensitive skin, you want to leave it on for just a few mins once a week and gradually work yourself up to 10 minutes. It burns/tingles a tiny bit, but nothing that isn't tolerable.

I used this 2 times a week and my face was so clear. Not so much right now because i haven't been consistent with it. I use the ordinary niacinamide after and moisturize. I recommend to not use this if you have anything open on your skin unless you are ok with a burning/tingly feeling. For me it also itches the first few mins.

No weird odors, easy to smear on (dont get it on your lops!). Let sit for 10 minutes and rinse. Your skin will be instantly smoother. Love it. It does tingle, that lets me know its woeking!

This will burn your face off! In a good and bad way. It burns within a minute of putting it on and will make your skin red and temder. But day 2…… is amazing! Smooth as silk! avis.titre: Holy grail for textured skin and hyperpigmentation
avis.texte: I bought this for hyperpigmentation on my body from insect bites. This product helped fade the marks quickly. It is also great for clearing hyperpigmentation from body acne scars. On the face, I notice an immediate glow and smoothness. I have lots of sebaceous filaments on my nose, causing it to feel bumpy but this peel made my nose baby smooth. However, if you use too much product or let it sit for too long, there will be redness on your face so be careful.

Stings a little but totally worth it. My combo skin can be hard to care for, but this exfoliant helps slough off the dry patches that have a habit of clogging my pores. My complexion is clearer and my make-up goes on smoother.

If you use this correctly, it is amazing! I have very oily skin and I get a lot of closed comedones and blackheads which is why I purchased this product - and it's very affordable. Using this only once a week, leaving it on for 5-7 minutes, then generously applying my moisturizer has made a huge difference in my skin! My face is finally baby smooth again and my pores are clearer almost immediately after using this resulting in plump, brighter skin. I wouldn't recommend using this on active or inflamed acne, and I definitely don't recommend using it as often as the bottle states…seriously, don't use it that often. A lot of irriation can come from potent products like this, but if you're careful using it and not overly sensitive, it really does work wonders!
This messed up my face sooo bad. Never again it hurt so much and dried up my face badly. Really disappointed.
This is the best product that you'll find to brighten your skin from acne spots!
Love the quality and affordability of the entire product line.

avis.titre: Yes, I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This product works really well for my skin. It calms down my rosacea and tightens my pores. I really like it. I use it about three times a week. It's convenient. It's not messy. Actually makes my skin feel more taught and it's easy on my purse. I highly recommend you give it a try.

avis.titre: Not correct pH so it doesn't work
avis.texte: In order for alpha hydroxy, beta hydroxy (salicylic acid) or ANY acid to work, this has to be at the very important pH level. This isn't. I happen to keep the strips around. It doesn't do anything except make your face look bloody, and that's added dye.

Traveled to Saudia Arabia abd didn't wear sun screen. I had several uneven areas there were darker than the rest of my face. So 5 stars if you purchase it in store. Great product, but poor packaging. I love the fact that its a peel and it works - but its gentle enough that it doesn't just eviscerate my sensitives skin like most peels.

The second time I left it on for the full 10 minutes and didn't have a bad reaction (this was a week later) so I'm confidant I can incorporate this into a weekly routine. I do not apply anything afterwards except the Estée Lauder night serum and a rich night cream. It's just kind of a pain waiting for 10 minutes when I could use a physical exfoliation and be done with my night routine so that's really my only complaint.

avis.titre: Pain is Beauty, and she is definitely a Beauty
avis.texte: Let me preface this by saying my skin is NOT sensitive. I can brush my cheek with rubbing alcohol and not even flinch, but this stuff stings even my tough skin. So those with sensitive skin may want to pass. I also worked my way up to using this by starting with the 5% lactic acid for a month (which felt like water), then the 10% lactic acid (which I use two or three times a week). This is for a DEEP cleanse. I use it around once a month, or if my skin is looking especially rough. I follow the instructions for the maximum time of 10 minutes before rinsing it off and I always walk away with baby smooth skin. I follow it up with CosRX snail mucin, a nice gentle essence, and a lightweight moisturizer to help soothe the skin and prevent any redness. I've never gotten a chemical burn like others report, but I'm also careful not to overdo it or use physical exfoliation with it. And I make sure to avoid any other actives like retinol, retinoids, or Vitamin C after. This is POWERFUL stuff, so be careful, follow the instructions, and you will be rewarded with noticeably softer skin.

I've used this for a year, mainly when I'm breaking out but the next day after usage kid you not my redness, and acne is almost gone, healing and if I use it again the following day with some ice cubes after usage acne is gone!

Ive never done an acid peel before, but i was really trying to find a fresh dewy glow and minimize my pores. I washed and dried my face well, and then applied a very light coat of product. Since product is red its easy to see where it is on ur face! Then set my timer for 9 mins (bottle says do not go over 10 mins) since my skin is slightly sensative i errored on the side of caution. After my timer went off, I immediately rinsed the product off. I noticed the product did make my skin tingle in the folds of my nose where there was slightly more product. So, beware of applying evenly. Once the products was completely gone, i applied a toner and some moisturizer WITH SPF!!! (The SPF is important as the product does have AHA in it!!) i am SO happy with the results!!! I will continue to follow instructions to ONLY use once a week and will hopefully continue to minimize my pores and dewy fresh skin!!!

How do I know it was the product? Because I don't get pimples any more due to age and this is the only product change that I made.
I exfoliate once a week with a 15% acid and use this once a month. It's strong. My skin doesn't need more but everyone is different. I will continue to use.

My aged skin really appreciates this product. After use my skin feels so smooth and looks healthier. The product has a slight burning sensation during use but I've never had a peel (at home or done professionally) not burn a bit.
This weekly peel works wonders. It helps to get rid of breakouts and leaves my skin feeling soft snd smooth. It's slowly getting rid if some stubborn blackheads as well.

avis.titre: How does this not have 5 stars?
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a long time and I can tell you it is worth it. The price point and the results are unmatched. Yes, it burns when you first put it on but if you can get through that, you'll love the results. I typically use this once or twice a week and make sure to follow with a moisturizer so it doesn't dry my skin out too much!

avis.titre: How does this product not have 5 stars?
avis.texte: This peeling solution is incredible. My skin feels so soft after I use it. My makeup goes on smoother, and the texture of my skin has improved...it's nothing short of awesome. I can't speak to dark spots because I don't have any, but I have lots of textural bumps from congested pores on my face, and these have improved considerably. I'm 46 years old and can say that this product is great for dry, mature skin! I totally agree with the reviews that say not to use this on open skin, though. It really stings if you do. I use The Ordinary 100% Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil after I use this, followed by La Roche Posay Toleriane Dermallergo Soothing Repair Moisturizer for Sensitive Skin, which seems to be moisturizing enough.

avis.titre: Great little at home light peel product.
avis.texte: This is easy to use and mild enough for home user. I love this line as a professional esthetician to suggest to clients.

I use this once a week instead of the recommend two because it's super strong. It stings a tiny bit when you first apply it but after waiting ten minutes you rinse your face thoroughly and apply your other lotions and creams. It can dry your face out if you don't tend to it right away with something to rehydrate and you'll peel a little bit in the coming days after use but it works! Maybe too well, but still works!

First off, be careful the state of your skin when you use this. If you have a compromised skin barrier, use something gentler until you get your skin calmed down. This really works. It WILL tingle and I am a seasoned user of peels. Do not leave on for longer than the 10 min. After use, please use a real rich serum and cream that has skin loving ingredients. It is important to not overuse this as well. Start off a couple times a week if not just once. As your skin builds tolerance, you can build use. just remember to moisturize, moisturize if you tend to be dry. Even oily, be sure to use a good cream bc your skin makes more oil when you "strip" it. It sounds kind of backwards but, true. I love this peel for it's economical, effectiveness! I am 55 and I try to keep my face looking young with lots of different products. I hope it works for you too! :)

I absolutely love this peeling solution. It's inexpensive compared to other peels and gets the job done! I've been using it for a few years, it got rid of dark spots and I never had new ones appear. About 6 months ago I ran out and my local target seemed to be sold out every time I went - a few weeks ago I started noticing two dark spots appearing on my skin after years of not having any appear. The only change in my routine was running out of this. Quickly re purchased and already notice them fading. I use 1-2x a week (sometimes more, sometimes less) but always for the 10 minutes.

This is the only product that helps clear up my skin's congestion and gives me a smooth texture. The purging period is terrible but so worth it. Excellent for PCOS/hormonal acne. Great for mature skin. Make sure to start slow and work your way up to more frequent use as well.

Use a moisturizer afterwards.
I use this every 10-14 days. It dissolves dead skin and refreshes my complexion. I is gentle but makes a big difference in my skin"s appearance.

avis.titre: The only product I buy again and again
avis.texte: I unfortunately have aging AND acne prone skin. I have been through ao many products, from good molecules to dermalogica to curology to drunk elephant. But nothing has visibly changed my skin the wat this product does. I used to deal with bad flaking combined with oily spots, but my skin is so even now. No flakes. No super shiny spots. Just allover dewy and even. I use it twice a week, after i cleanse my face in the shower so my pores are more open. I leave it for 15 minutes instead of 10, and wipe it off with a textured cotton pad for extra exfoliation. I don't have super sensitive skin so this works well for me, and ive used it for 4 years now so i know how much my skin can stand. Obviously tread lightly if you are new to the product! Start with 5 minutes if it burns too much and work your way up. And yes. It's supposed to burn! It's not comfortable. So many reviews complaining about this, but thats how a chemical peel works. If you don't feel it, its not removing your dead skin. Make sure you moisturize IMMEDIATELY after! Your skin will be very tight and clean. You'll feel so glowy! I'm not exaggerating when i say this product changed my life. My acne and confidence were so bad before. Using this consistently made all the difference. The photo shows my skin before, then 8 months later (i had been using the this product for 5 months at that point. Discoloration is still there but slowly fading!)

I have only used it once, but I can update if I have farther opinions later on. I used the product for around four minutes, because I heard other people got irritated and burns for using it too long. I wouldn't recommend for someone with sensitive skin.

#1 instrction on the box: MOISTURIZE PRIOR TO USE. This is an ACID (aka At Home chemical peel). While its not nearly as strong as what a plactic surgeon uses, it is still two acids. I recommend doing a SMALL patch test, perhaps near the hairline where your hair will cover it. The moisturize protects against actual acid burn- but yes, acid peels have a burning sensation. Intolerable may not be the product, but your sensitive skin. BABY STEPS and not all AHA/BHA peels are created equal; Research first and Choose Wisely.

The smell is a bit off-putting but the much bigger issue is that it IMMEDIATELY began irritating and burning my skin. I lasted 30 seconds before washing it off. It's now been another 2 minutes since I removed it and my skin it still itchy and stings. I'm glad it works for other people, but I would advise those with sensitive skin to stay away!!

Originally bought this for my daughter to help with her acne then I decided to give it a try and I am hooked! I use this about once a week and my skin is instantly brighter and more fresh looking! It also helps to keep my skin and pores clear. I was using a salicylic and glycolic acid product but this one works better. I started with only 5 min then worked my way up to 10 min at a time.

Only used the product three times so far. The first time, I limited the minutes to about 5 instead of ten and all went well. It left my skin a little smoother and no bad reaction. The second time didn't seem to make much a difference but left me with a few break outs. The third time at the full 10 minutes was a charm and showed some significant improvement. Being over 60, this peeling solution is nice to have since I have acne scar and some sun damage. Hoping continued well spaced usage will continue to improve the texture and tone and smooth out my skin over time.
